#[derive(Clone)]
struct Process {
    name: String,
    entity: String,
    path: Vec<String>,
    qualifier: Option<String>,
    stages: Vec<String>,
    initial: String,
    transitions: Vec<ProcessTransition>,
    span: fsl_syntax::Span,
}

#[must_use]
pub fn ai_tool_sets(component: &fsl_syntax::AiComponent) -> AiToolSets<'_> {
    AiToolSets {
        suggestible: component
            .authority
            .may_suggest
            .iter()
            .map(|rule| rule.name.as_str())
            .collect(),
        executable: component
            .authority
            .may_execute
            .iter()
            .chain(&component.authority.requires_human_approval)
            .map(|rule| rule.name.as_str())
            .collect(),
        approval_required: component
            .authority
            .requires_human_approval
            .iter()
            .map(|rule| rule.name.as_str())
            .chain(
                component
                    .tools
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|tool| tool.irreversible)
                    .map(|tool| tool.name.as_str()),
            )
            .collect(),
        forbidden: component
            .authority
            .forbidden
            .iter()
            .map(|rule| rule.name.as_str())
            .collect(),
    }
}
